description: This Java class 'Version2Header' generates a header file with version control information based on SVN output and provided arguments.

classes.name: Version2Header
classes.description: Main class that retrieves SVN info and generates a header file with version and git hash.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Creates 'svnversion.h' with version and git hash information.
